articles.title: 11 European countries send troops to Poland military exercise for potential postwar Ukraine mission
articles.description: Thousands of European troops are taking part in an unprecedented military exercise in southeastern Poland to prepare for a potential postwar mission in Ukraine aimed at helping to stabilize the country and rebuild its military once the war ends.
